# Locally maintained skill attributions

These skills were adapted from the pinned upstream copies listed below. They
are maintained in this catalog and are excluded from automatic upstream skill
synchronization. Their public names and installation paths are unchanged.

The September 2026 instruction pass clarified activation, reduced unnecessary
context and procedure, and aligned phase completion with the user’s requested
scope. The retained license labels come from the original source lock; existing
license files and author metadata remain with their skills. Each entrypoint also
records its upstream repository, original path, revision, and license in metadata.

No upstream revision was advanced during conversion. To adopt a future upstream
change, review and integrate it deliberately while preserving local behavior.
Catalog inheritance still distributes these adaptations and this attribution
record; local maintenance here describes ownership relative to the original
upstream repository, not an opt-out from parent-catalog inheritance.
